description: Cancel a pending reschedule request (SessionRequest) on behalf of the client who proposed it — the client-side withdrawal in the bilateral loop (outcome=cancelled_by_client). Idempotent: a request already cancelled_by_client returns wasAlreadyCancelled=true; a request in another terminal state returns a conflict. Use booking_list_requests to find pending requests; use booking_resolve_request for the org's own approve/reject.
name: portal_cancel_reschedule_request
